items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: I asked Cozie, I said, how do you execute that? So he told me.

ctx.x: I guess I was a natural. I finally heard -- I'm jumping a little bit. I finally heard Cozy Cole playing a solo known as Ratamacue. That's what it sounded like, Ratamacue. And Paradiddles is the name of it, paradiddle, paradiddle. In other words, paradiddle, paradiddle, see how my hands are going? Right, left, right, right, left, left, so on. So I asked Cozie, I said, how do you execute that? So he told me. It's in there in the book. I said, what book?
And I got this book that I learned how to do my ratamakes and the paradiddles. Rolls, I always had some kind of rolls. And I did that. And so --
